title: COLOSSIANS 3
THE MIDDAY WATCH
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: warm sunbeams through a quiet wooden office window at noon
empty wooden desk with soft midday light streaming across it
sunlight pouring over a simple workspace in deep stillness
quiet afternoon sun illuminating a calm solitary room
high noon light resting peacefully on empty wooden boards
gentle midday rays falling across a serene quiet study

scenes.a: If that routine task before you feels hidden and utterly unseen today, stay here.
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
Lord, quiet our restless hearts in this midday hour and purify every motive within us.
Help us to work with gladness, remembering that our ultimate service belongs to you alone.
May our daily efforts bring glory to your name throughout the remainder of this day.
